messages.subject: Nick | Industrial, Energy & Government Relations Executive | GCC Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Cunningham,

I am sharing my profile for senior industrial, energy, infrastructure and natural-resources leadership mandates across the Middle East.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major mining operation undergoing substantial capital investment and energy-transition activity.

Your work across infrastructure, energy, transportation, logistics, manufacturing and industrial services in the Middle East makes this a strong sector match.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles across Government Relations, External Affairs, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships and related country-facing leadership functions. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE and wider region.

I have attached a GCC-focused executive CV. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
